games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.blurb: Every choice matters, every roll counts, and every plan still goes wrong.
FromSoftware gave you a whole open world to die in, and you thanked them for it.
Steal hearts by night and pass your exams by day. Pure style, start to finish.
Recruit a crew, earn their loyalty, then find out who survives the suicide mission.
Turn-based combat you have to parry and dodge, and a story that will wreck you.
No combat. Just you, your skills and a murder you're far too hungover to solve.
The Mojave, four factions and a bullet in the head. Still the best Fallout.
No dragons and no magic, just 15th-century Bohemia rebuilt in astonishing detail.
Fifteen years and countless re-releases later, and we still haven't finished it.
